objective: Update locked runtime dependencies with known fixed releases after the main-branch dependency audit reported vulnerabilities in certifi and Pillow.

Dependency audit identified certifi 2026.7.22 (PYSEC-2026-4320; fixed version reported as 2026.10.19) and Pillow 12.3.0 (eight CVEs; fixed version reported as 13.0.0).

expected_improvement: Remove the specific known vulnerable dependency versions identified by the CI audit.
Keep dependency audit fail-closed and retain exact dependency pins.
Verify package/test compatibility and rerun the full gated CI.

security.before: 9 known vulnerabilities reported across certifi 2026.7.22 and Pillow 12.3.0
security.after: Pending CI verification against updated lock

compatibility.before: Main-branch tests and package build passed before dependency update
compatibility.after: Pending full CI verification after dependency update

evidence: Lockfile pins updated to certifi==2026.10.19 and pillow==13.0.0 based on fixed versions reported by the failing audit.
No scientific baseline, model artifact, feature definition, taxonomy, or scientific acceptance threshold is changed.

root_causes: The committed lockfile retained certifi 2026.7.22 and Pillow 12.3.0 despite the dependency audit reporting fixed versions.

findings: A green test suite and package build do not establish dependency security; the separate audit remains a release-blocking gate.
Dependency pins must be refreshed to versions explicitly identified as fixed and then revalidated through the full pipeline.

open_blockers: Await successful dependency audit and full CI on this branch.

knowledge_carried_forward: Do not bypass pip-audit or relax the CI gate to obtain a green workflow.
